reviews.author: John M.
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic pasta! The homemade tagliatelle was perfectly al dente, and the truffle cream sauce was to die for. Best Italian food I've had in this city.

reviews.author: Sarah K.
reviews.text: The food was okay but the service was terrible. We waited 45 minutes before anyone even took our order. Our waiter seemed completely disinterested and got two items wrong.

reviews.author: Mike R.
reviews.text: Worst dining experience ever. The restaurant was filthy — sticky tables, dirty floors, and I found a hair in my soup. The bathroom was disgusting. Will never return.

reviews.author: Emily T.
reviews.text: Lovely ambiance with dim lighting and soft Italian music. The decor is charming and romantic, perfect for a date night. Food was good too, though a bit pricey.

reviews.author: David L.
reviews.text: Extremely overpriced for what you get. A small plate of spaghetti for $28? The portions are tiny and the quality doesn't justify the cost at all. Total rip-off.

reviews.author: Lisa W.
reviews.text: Average experience. The pizza was decent but nothing special. Service was slow but the staff were friendly enough. The wait time to get a table was about 30 minutes even with a reservation.

reviews.author: Chris P.
reviews.text: The chef really knows what he's doing! The osso buco was melt-in-your-mouth tender, and the tiramisu was the best I've ever tasted. Incredible flavors throughout the meal.

reviews.author: Anna B.
reviews.text: Waited over an hour for our main course. When it finally arrived, my steak was overcooked and cold. The manager offered no apology or compensation. Extremely disappointing service.

reviews.author: Tom H.
reviews.text: Great wine selection and the sommelier really knew his stuff. The bruschetta appetizer was fresh and delicious. Would recommend for the drinks alone.

reviews.author: Rachel G.
reviews.text: Found a cockroach near our table. The place clearly has hygiene issues. The kitchen looked messy through the open window. Health inspector should visit this place.

reviews.author: James F.
reviews.text: The food is decent but they really need to work on their wait times. We had a reservation for 7pm and didn't get seated until 7:30. Then waited another 40 minutes for appetizers.

reviews.author: Olivia N.
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant with amazing food. The seafood risotto was creamy and packed with fresh shrimp and mussels. The staff were attentive and made us feel welcome.

reviews.author: Daniel S.
reviews.text: Way too expensive. We spent $200 for two people and left hungry. The portions are laughably small. You're basically paying for the name and location, not the food quality.

reviews.author: Sophie C.
reviews.text: The ambiance is wonderful — candlelit tables, beautiful art on the walls, and a lovely patio area. Food quality was solid too. Only downside is the noise level gets high on weekends.

reviews.author: Kevin A.
reviews.text: Rude staff and terrible management. When I complained about cold food, the waiter rolled his eyes. The manager was dismissive and condescending. Zero customer service skills.

reviews.author: Patricia D.
reviews.text: The tonkotsu ramen is absolutely incredible! Rich, creamy broth that has been simmered for hours. The chashu pork melts in your mouth. Authentic Japanese flavors.

reviews.author: Brian J.
reviews.text: Terrible service. The staff were rude and rushed us through our meal. They brought the wrong order twice and didn't apologize. Never going back to this place.

reviews.author: Nancy E.
reviews.text: Great ramen with generous portions. The spicy miso ramen had a nice kick and the noodles were perfectly cooked. Prices are reasonable for the quality you get.

reviews.author: George V.
reviews.text: The restaurant is cramped and uncomfortable. Tables are too close together, the noise level is unbearable, and the chairs are incredibly hard. Not a pleasant dining environment at all.

reviews.author: Helen Y.
reviews.text: Best ramen in town! The gyoza appetizers are crispy and flavorful, and their matcha ice cream dessert is divine. Every dish we tried was excellent quality.

reviews.author: Steven U.
reviews.text: Found the place quite dirty. Spills on the floor, greasy menus, and the chopsticks had food residue on them. Clearly they don't care about cleanliness or hygiene standards.

reviews.author: Karen I.
reviews.text: The food is good but the wait time is ridiculous. We waited 25 minutes just to place our order and another 35 for the food. Way too slow for a ramen shop.

reviews.author: Robert Z.
reviews.text: Love the authentic atmosphere with Japanese decor and music. The sushi rolls were fresh and beautifully presented. Great date spot if you get there early.

reviews.author: Maria X.
reviews.text: Overpriced for ramen. $18 for a basic bowl with barely any toppings? And they charge extra for an egg? Other ramen places in the area offer much better value.

reviews.author: William O.
reviews.text: Outstanding food quality. The black garlic ramen is a masterpiece — complex, deep umami flavor. The soft-boiled egg was perfectly runny. Chef clearly has serious skills.

reviews.author: Jessica Q.
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible customer service. The waiter was aggressive when we asked about allergens in the food. Manager refused to come to our table. Unacceptable behavior.

reviews.author: Thomas W.
reviews.text: Middle of the road experience. Ramen broth was a bit bland compared to other places. Noodles were fine. Nothing terrible but nothing that would make me come back specifically.

reviews.author: Linda M.
reviews.text: The bathroom was out of order and the restaurant was freezing cold. No one seemed to care about the temperature. Very uncomfortable and the food was lukewarm too.

reviews.author: Mark T.
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the variety on the menu. The takoyaki starter was crispy outside and soft inside. The curry ramen was a nice twist on the classic. Good portions for the price.

reviews.author: Susan R.
reviews.text: I got food poisoning after eating here. Spent two days sick. The raw fish clearly wasn't fresh. I've reported this to health authorities. Avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.author: Amanda L.
reviews.text: Incredible vegan food! The cauliflower steak was beautifully seasoned and the mushroom risotto was rich and creamy without any dairy. Proves plant-based food can be gourmet.

reviews.author: Peter K.
reviews.text: Very slow service. We waited over 40 minutes for two salads. The staff seemed overwhelmed and understaffed. When the food came, it was cold. Frustrating experience.

reviews.author: Diane H.
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant with a lovely garden patio. The natural lighting and plant decor make it feel like an oasis. Very Instagram-worthy. Food was fresh and tasty.

reviews.author: Frank J.
reviews.text: Absurdly overpriced. $22 for a small bowl of lentil soup? $16 for a side salad? This is highway robbery. The portions are tiny and the food is nothing special for the price.

reviews.author: Carol B.
reviews.text: The jackfruit tacos were mind-blowing! So flavorful and the texture was perfect. The acai bowl for dessert was beautiful and delicious. Top-notch plant-based cuisine.

reviews.author: Henry N.
reviews.text: Disgusting hygiene standards. Saw a mouse run across the floor near the kitchen. Tables were not properly cleaned between guests. Lost my appetite immediately.

reviews.author: Ruth D.
reviews.text: The food is okay for vegan cuisine. Nothing that blew me away. The wait time was about 30 minutes which felt long for what we ordered. Staff were polite though.

reviews.author: Paul G.
reviews.text: Great menu variety for a plant-based restaurant. The Beyond burger was juicy and the sweet potato fries were crispy. Fair prices compared to similar restaurants in the area.

reviews.author: Betty F.
reviews.text: The waiter was incredibly rude and impatient. When we asked questions about the menu, he sighed loudly. No smile, no warmth. The food was fine but the service ruined it.

reviews.author: Edward C.
reviews.text: Exceptional quality ingredients. You can taste the freshness in every bite. The avocado toast with heirloom tomatoes was simple but perfect. Great smoothie selection too.

reviews.author: Gloria A.
reviews.text: Terrible value for money. We spent $85 for two people and both left hungry. The plates look artistic but contain barely any food. All style, no substance.

reviews.author: Arthur E.
reviews.text: Decent enough but the place was freezing. The heating clearly wasn't working and staff didn't seem to care. Food was average — the pasta was undercooked and underseasoned.

reviews.author: Dorothy P.
reviews.text: Love the eco-friendly approach — compostable packaging, no plastic straws, locally sourced ingredients. The Buddha bowl was colorful and nutritious. A feel-good dining experience.

reviews.author: Charles S.
reviews.text: The noise level in this restaurant is absurd. We could barely hear each other talk. The acoustics are terrible with all the hard surfaces. Food was mediocre at best.

reviews.author: Margaret W.
reviews.text: Appalling customer service. The manager argued with us when we pointed out a wrong order. She raised her voice and other diners were staring. Completely unprofessional.
